content.text: {"story":{"as_a":"user","i_want":"edit the title, description, priority and Due Date of an existing task","so_that":"I can correct or update my to-do items as plans change","business_description":"Users can change the editable fields of a task they already created. The edit uses the same validation rules as task creation: the title must be non-empty and at most 100 characters, and the Due Date must not be earlier than the Creation Date. The Frontend shows a success or error message after every update and never shows a success state when the Backend request fails.","business_value":"Users keep their personal task list accurate without deleting and recreating tasks, which preserves the task's Creation Date and ID.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"An existing task with a valid title, description, priority and Due Date not earlier than its Creation Date","when":"The user opens the edit form, changes the title to another non-empty value of 100 characters or fewer, and submits the form","then":"The backend stores the new title, sets the Last Updated Date to the time of the update, and the task shows the new title in the list after the backend returns success"},{"given":"An existing task with a valid title, description, priority and Due Date","when":"The user changes the description, priority and Due Date to other allowed values and submits the form","then":"The backend stores each changed value and the frontend displays a success message after the backend returns success"},{"given":"An existing task being edited in the form","when":"The user clears the title field and submits the form","then":"The backend rejects the update with a missing mandatory field error, the task keeps its previous title, and the form shows the error message 'Title is mandatory' and no success message"},{"given":"An existing task with Creation Date 2024-05-10","when":"The user sets the Due Date to 2024-05-09 and submits the update","then":"The backend rejects the update with a validation error, the stored Due Date is unchanged, and the frontend shows an error message and no success message"},{"given":"An existing task with a title of 100 characters","when":"The user changes the title to 101 characters and submits the update","then":"The backend rejects the update with a validation error, the stored title is unchanged, and the frontend shows the error message 'Title must be 100 characters or fewer' and no success message"},{"given":"A task update request where the backend returns an error response","when":"The frontend receives the error response","then":"The task list still shows the previous values for that task, the form does not show the task as updated, and an error message is displayed"},{"given":"A task update request where the backend returns a success response","when":"The frontend receives the success response","then":"The frontend displays a success message after the update action"},{"given":"An update request has been sent for an existing task and the backend has not yet responded","when":"The edit form is waiting for the response","then":"The task list still shows the previous values for that task and no success message is shown"},{"given":"A task ID that does not exist in the database","when":"An update request is sent for that ID","then":"The backend returns a Task Not Found error, no data is changed, and the frontend shows an error message and does not show a success state"},{"given":"An existing task with a Last Updated Date of 2024-05-10 10:00:00 UTC","when":"An update request for that task is rejected by validation","then":"The Last Updated Date remains 2024-05-10 10:00:00 UTC and the frontend shows an error message and does not show a success state"},{"given":"An existing task and an update request with a Priority value outside Low, Medium and High, for example Urgent","when":"The backend validates the request","then":"The backend returns an invalid input error, the stored task is unchanged, and the frontend shows an error message"},{"given":"An existing task and an update request that fails with a database error on the backend","when":"The backend writes the update to the database and the write fails","then":"The backend returns an internal server error, the stored task keeps its previous values including the Last Updated Date, and the frontend shows an error message instead of a success message"}],"edge_cases":["A title of exactly 100 characters is accepted; a title of 101 characters is rejected.","A Due Date equal to the Creation Date is accepted because the rule only rejects dates earlier than the Creation Date.","Open question: the PRD says the title must be non-empty but does not say whether a title containing only spaces is empty. The team must decide and document this.","Open question: the PRD does not state whether Creation Date can be edited. This story does not allow editing it.","Status and Completion Date are not editable in this story; status changes belong to the Mark as Completed story.","If the task is deleted by another user or session before the update is sent, the backend returns Task Not Found and the frontend shows an error message.","Open question: the PRD does not state the exact wording of the Task Not Found and internal server error messages shown to the user."],"dependencies":["US-create-task","US-view-task-list"],"definition_of_done":["PUT /tasks/{id} updates title, description, priority and Due Date and sets Last Updated Date on each successful write.","Title validation (non-empty, maximum 100 characters) and Due Date validation match the create rules.","Task Not Found, invalid input, missing mandatory field and internal server or database error responses are returned as specified and leave stored data unchanged.","The edit form reuses the create form with existing values pre-filled.","The frontend shows a success message only after a success response and an error message after any error response.","The task list keeps the previous values while a request is pending or after a failed request.","Automated tests cover every acceptance criterion and pass."]},"tasks":[{"key_slug":"update-task-endpoint","title":"[BE] Add PUT /tasks/{id} endpoint to update title, description, priority and Due Date","track":"backend","area":"backend","description":"Accept title, description, priority and Due Date for an existing task. Apply the same title and Due Date rules as create. Set Last Updated Date only on a successful write. Do not change Creation Date, Status or Completion Date.","size":"M","consumes_api":false,"touches_db":true,"requirement_ids":["R-bc3213df","R-244669c0","R-03df7815","R-efe1e5d4","R-0b1853d6"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["PUT /tasks/{id} accepts title, description, priority and Due Date.","Empty titles and titles longer than 100 characters are rejected with a validation error.","Due Date earlier than Creation Date is rejected with a validation error.","Last Updated Date is set to the time of a successful update.","Creation Date, Status and Completion Date are not changed by the endpoint.","Unit tests cover each validation rule and the success path."]},{"key_slug":"update-task-error-responses","title":"[BE] Return Task Not Found, invalid input and server error responses for task update","track":"backend","area":"backend","description":"Return the simple error responses required for the update endpoint: Task Not Found for an unknown ID, invalid input for an out-of-range value such as a Priority outside Low, Medium and High, missing mandatory field, and internal server or database error when the write fails. Leave stored data unchanged on every error.","size":"S","consumes_api":false,"touches_db":true,"requirement_ids":["R-9dc414dc"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["An unknown task ID returns a Task Not Found error and changes no data.","A Priority value outside Low, Medium and High returns an invalid input error and changes no data.","A failed database write returns an internal server error and keeps the previous values, including Last Updated Date.","Each error response uses the same simple format as the other task endpoints.","Tests cover each error response."]},{"key_slug":"task-edit-form-prefill","title":"[FE] Reuse task form in edit mode with existing values pre-filled","track":"frontend","area":"frontend","description":"Open the existing task form in edit mode with the current title, description, priority and Due Date filled in. While the request is pending, keep the previous values in the list. After a failed request, keep the previous values and do not mark the task as updated.","size":"S","consumes_api":true,"touches_db":false,"requirement_ids":["R-d57336f7","R-ab9e9cb0","R-bc3213df"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["A success message appears only after a success response.","An error message appears after any error response, including Task Not Found and internal server errors.","No success state is shown when the backend request fails.","The task list shows the previous values while the request is pending and after a failure.","Component tests cover success, error and pending states."]},{"key_slug":"task-update-test-suite","title":"[QA] Add test suite for editing an existing task across API and form","track":"qa_general","area":"qa","description":"Test the update flow end to end across the PUT endpoint, the database and the edit form, including validation, error responses and feedback messages.","size":"M","consumes_api":true,"touches_db":true,"requirement_ids":["R-bc3213df","R-9b30a145","R-03df7815","R-efe1e5d4","R-d57336f7","R-244669c0","R-9dc414dc","R-0b1853d6","R-ab9e9cb0"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["Tests cover a successful update of each editable field and the Last Updated Date change.","Tests cover empty title, title of 101 characters, Due Date before Creation Date and Priority Urgent.","Tests cover Task Not Found, validation rejection and database failure, and confirm stored values are unchanged.","Tests confirm no success message or success state is shown when the backend request fails.","The suite runs in CI and passes."]}]}
